system.description: Armor Class: 6 Hit Dice: 4 (M) Move: 120' (40') Attacks: 2 claws or 1 rock Damage: 1d4/ld4 or 1d6 No. Appearing: 1d6 (2d4) Save As: F2 Morale: 7 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 2 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 75 Rock baboons form packs of up to 30 members, each pack led by a dominant male. They are ferocious and have vicious tempers. They do not speak a true language, but use simple screams to communicate warnings and needs.
